changes: Removes the strict pre-Remove SAB identity ping that could falsely report engine reconnecting while active downloads remained healthy.
Verifies individual Remove directly against the target SAB Queue/History ID using bounded idempotent retries.
Makes Remove all failed truly bulk at the SAB control plane with one targeted multi-ID Queue/History verification pass and one History deletion mutation.
Allows terminal History proof to complete cleanup through a transient Queue read reset while never hiding a job proven live in SAB Queue.
Keeps local removal tombstones authoritative if terminal SAB History cleanup itself resets after transfer absence has already been proven.
Preserves the v3.6.25 Automation backlog, fail-closed Smart Import, franchise/edition protection, state-write throttling, and library-integrity diagnostics.
regression_guards: v3.6.25 Automation backlog and Smart Import reliability behavior remains intact.
v3.6.24 durable Download Statistics remain persistent and accurate.
v3.6.23 accent-insensitive title matching remains accepted.
v3.6.22 unresolved/obfuscated binary downloads and v3.6.21 Related Media behavior remain unchanged.
Active SAB Queue jobs are never locally hidden without fresh proof that removal is safe.
